versos.grego: Ὄφελον ἀνείχεσθέ μου μικρόν τι ἀφροσύνης· ἀλλὰ καὶ ἀνέχεσθέ μου.

controles.web: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.
controles.kjv: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.
controles.livre: Gostaria que me suportásseis um pouco em minha loucura; mas ainda assim suportai-me.

versos.grego: ζηλῶ γὰρ ὑμᾶς Θεοῦ ζήλῳ, ἡρμοσάμην γὰρ ὑμᾶς ἑνὶ ἀνδρὶ παρθένον ἁγνὴν παραστῆσαι τῷ Χριστῷ·

controles.web: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I married you to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
controles.kjv: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.
controles.livre: Pois estou zeloso de vós com zelo de Deus, porque tenho vos preparado para vos apresentar como uma virgem pura, a um marido, isto é, a Cristo.

versos.grego: φοβοῦμαι δὲ μή πως, ὡς ὁ ὄφις ἐξηπάτησεν Εὕαν ἐν τῇ πανουργίᾳ αὐτοῦ, φθαρῇ τὰ νοήματα ὑμῶν ἀπὸ τῆς ἁπλότητος καὶ τῆς ἁγνότητος τῆς εἰς Χριστόν.

controles.web: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
controles.kjv: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
controles.livre: Mas temo que, assim como a serpente enganou a Eva com sua astúcia, também assim em alguma maneira vossas mentes se corrompam da simplicidade que está em Cristo.

versos.grego: εἰ μὲν γὰρ ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἄλλον Ἰησοῦν κηρύσσει ὃν οὐκ ἐκηρύξαμεν, ἢ πνεῦμα ἕτερον λαμβάνετε ὃ οὐκ ἐλάβετε, ἢ εὐαγγέλιον ἕτερον ὃ οὐκ ἐδέξασθε, καλῶς ἀνέχεσθε.

controles.web: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus, whom we did not preach, or if you receive a different spirit, which you did not receive, or a different “good news”, which you did not accept, you put up with that well enough.
controles.kjv: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.
controles.livre: Porque se aquele que vem pregasse a outro Jesus que nós não temos pregado, ou se recebêsseis outro espírito que não recebestes, ou evangelho diferente do que aceitastes, certamente vós o aceitaríeis.

versos.grego: λογίζομαι γὰρ μηδὲν ὑστερηκέναι τῶν ὑπερλίαν ἀποστόλων.

controles.web: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.
controles.kjv: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
controles.livre: Porque penso que eu em nada fui inferior aos mais excelentes apóstolos.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ καὶ ἰδιώτης τῷ λόγῳ, ἀλλ’ οὐ τῇ γνώσει, ἀλλ’ ἐν παντὶ φανερώσαντες ἐν πᾶσιν εἰς ὑμᾶς.

controles.web: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.
controles.kjv: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.
controles.livre: E se também sou rude na palavra, contudo não o sou no conhecimento; mas em tudo já estamos totalmente manifestos entre vós.

versos.grego: Ἢ ἁμαρτίαν ἐποίησα ἐμαυτὸν ταπεινῶν ἵνα ὑμεῖς ὑψωθῆτε, ὅτι δωρεὰν τὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ εὐαγγέλιον εὐηγγελισάμην ὑμῖν;

controles.web: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?
controles.kjv: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?
controles.livre: Por acaso pequei ao humilhar a mim mesmo, para que vós fôsseis exaltados, por eu ter vos anunciado gratuitamente o Evangelho de Deus?

versos.grego: ἄλλας ἐκκλησίας ἐσύλησα λαβὼν ὀψώνιον πρὸς τὴν ὑμῶν διακονίαν,

controles.web: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.
controles.kjv: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.
controles.livre: Eu tomei o que era de outras igrejas, ao receber salário, para servir a vós; e quando eu estava presente convosco, e tendo necessidade, a ninguém incomodei com algum encargo.

versos.grego: καὶ παρὼν πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ ὑστερηθεὶς οὐ κατενάρκησα οὐθενός· τὸ γὰρ ὑστέρημά μου προσανεπλήρωσαν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ἐλθόντες ἀπὸ Μακεδονίας· καὶ ἐν παντὶ ἀβαρῆ ἐμαυτὸν ὑμῖν ἐτήρησα καὶ τηρήσω.

controles.web: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.
controles.kjv: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.
controles.livre: Porque os irmãos que vieram da Macedônia supriram minha falta; e em tudo eu me guardei de vos ser incômodo, e ainda me guardarei.

versos.grego: ἔστιν ἀλήθεια Χριστοῦ ἐν ἐμοὶ, ὅτι ἡ καύχησις αὕτη οὐ φραγήσεται εἰς ἐμὲ ἐν τοῖς κλίμασιν τῆς Ἀχαΐας.

controles.web: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
controles.kjv: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
controles.livre: A verdade de Cristo está em mim, de modo que este meu orgulho não me será impedido nas regiões da Acaia.

versos.grego: διὰ τί; ὅτι οὐκ ἀγαπῶ ὑμᾶς; ὁ Θεὸς οἶδεν.

controles.web: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.
controles.kjv: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.
controles.livre: Por que? Porque não vos amo? Deus o sabe.

versos.grego: Ὃ δὲ ποιῶ, καὶ ποιήσω, ἵνα ἐκκόψω τὴν ἀφορμὴν τῶν θελόντων ἀφορμήν, ἵνα ἐν ᾧ καυχῶνται εὑρεθῶσιν καθὼς καὶ ἡμεῖς.

controles.web: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them that desire an occasion, that in which they boast, they may be found even as we.
controles.kjv: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.
controles.livre: Mas o que eu faço, ainda o farei, para cortar a oportunidade daqueles que buscam oportunidade para serem considerados como nós naquilo em que se orgulham.

versos.grego: οἱ γὰρ τοιοῦτοι ψευδαπόστολοι, ἐργάται δόλιοι, μετασχηματιζόμενοι εἰς ἀποστόλους Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.
controles.kjv: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.
controles.livre: Porque tais falsos apóstolos são trabalhadores fraudulentos, fingindo serem apóstolos de Cristo.

versos.grego: καὶ οὐ θαῦμα· αὐτὸς γὰρ ὁ Σατανᾶς μετασχηματίζεται εἰς ἄγγελον φωτός.

controles.web: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.
controles.kjv: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
controles.livre: E isto não é algo maravilhoso; porque o mesmo Satanás se transforma fingindo ser anjo de luz.

versos.grego: οὐ μέγα οὖν εἰ καὶ οἱ διάκονοι αὐτοῦ μετασχηματίζονται ὡς διάκονοι δικαιοσύνης· ὧν τὸ τέλος ἔσται κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν.

controles.web: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.
controles.kjv: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.
controles.livre: Portanto não é muita surpresa se também seus trabalhadores se transformam, fingindo serem trabalhadores da justiça; o fim dos quais será conforme as suas obras.

versos.grego: Πάλιν λέγω, μή τίς με δόξῃ ἄφρονα εἶναι· εἰ δὲ μήγε, κἂν ὡς ἄφρονα δέξασθέ με, ἵνα κἀγὼ μικρόν τι καυχήσωμαι.

controles.web: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.
controles.kjv: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.
controles.livre: Outra vez digo, que ninguém pense que sou tolo; ou se não, recebei a mim como se eu fosse tolo, para que eu também me orgulhe um pouco.

versos.grego: ὃ λαλῶ, οὐ κατὰ Κύριον λαλῶ, ἀλλ’ ὡς ἐν ἀφροσύνῃ, ἐν ταύτῃ τῇ ὑποστάσει τῆς καυχήσεως.

controles.web: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.
controles.kjv: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
controles.livre: O que eu estou dizendo, não estou dizendo conforme o Senhor, mas sim como um tolo, nesta firme orgulho confiante.

versos.grego: ἐπεὶ πολλοὶ καυχῶνται κατὰ τὴν σάρκα, κἀγὼ καυχήσομαι.

controles.web: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.
controles.kjv: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
controles.livre: Porque muitos se orgulham segundo a carne; e também eu me orgulharei.

versos.grego: ἡδέως γὰρ ἀνέχεσθε τῶν ἀφρόνων φρόνιμοι ὄντες·

controles.web: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.
controles.kjv: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.
controles.livre: Porque vós, sendo tão sábios, tolerais com boa vontade os tolos.

versos.grego: ἀνέχεσθε γὰρ εἴ τις ὑμᾶς καταδουλοῖ, εἴ τις κατεσθίει, εἴ τις λαμβάνει, εἴ τις ἐπαίρεται, εἴ τις εἰς πρόσωπον ὑμᾶς δέρει.

controles.web: For you bear with a man, if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, if he strikes you on the face.
controles.kjv: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.
controles.livre: Pois vós tolerais se alguém vos põe como escravos, se alguém vos explora, se alguém se aproveita de vós , se alguém age com arrogância, se alguém vos fere no rosto.

versos.grego: κατὰ ἀτιμίαν λέγω, ὡς ὅτι ἡμεῖς ἠσθενήκαμεν. ἐν ᾧ δ’ ἄν τις τολμᾷ, ἐν ἀφροσύνῃ λέγω, τολμῶ κἀγώ.

controles.web: I speak by way of disparagement, as though we had been weak. Yet however any is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.
controles.kjv: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
controles.livre: Eu digo como algo desonroso, como se tivéssemos estado fracos; mas naquilo em que algum outro é atrevido, eu também sou atrevido (falo como tolo).

versos.grego: Ἑβραῖοί εἰσιν; κἀγώ. Ἰσραηλεῖταί εἰσιν; κἀγώ. σπέρμα Ἀβραάμ εἰσιν; κἀγώ.

controles.web: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? So am I.
controles.kjv: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
controles.livre: Eles são hebreus? Eu também. Eles são israelitas? Eu também. Eles são semente de Abraão? Eu também.

versos.grego: διάκονοι Χριστοῦ εἰσιν; παραφρονῶν λαλῶ, ὑπὲρ ἐγώ· ἐν κόποις περισσοτέρως, ἐν φυλακαῖς περισσοτέρως, ἐν πληγαῖς ὑπερβαλλόντως, ἐν θανάτοις πολλάκις.

controles.web: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself) I am more so; in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, in deaths often.
controles.kjv: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
controles.livre: Eles são servidores de Cristo? (Falo como tolo:) eu sou mais ainda; em trabalhos, muito mais; em feridas, mais; em prisões, muito mais; em perigo de morte, muitas vezes.

versos.grego: ὑπὸ Ἰουδαίων πεντάκις τεσσεράκοντα παρὰ μίαν ἔλαβον,

controles.web: Five times from the Jews I received forty stripes minus one.
controles.kjv: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.
controles.livre: Eu já recebi dos judeus cinco vezes quarenta açoites menos um.

versos.grego: τρὶς ἐραβδίσθην, ἅπαξ ἐλιθάσθην, τρὶς ἐναυάγησα, νυχθήμερον ἐν τῷ βυθῷ πεποίηκα·

controles.web: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.
controles.kjv: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;
controles.livre: Por três vezes já fui espancado com varas, uma vez fui apedrejado, três vezes sofri naufrágios, passei uma noite e um dia à deriva no mar profundo;

versos.grego: ὁδοιπορίαις πολλάκις, κινδύνοις ποταμῶν, κινδύνοις λῃστῶν, κινδύνοις ἐκ γένους, κινδύνοις ἐξ ἐθνῶν, κινδύνοις ἐν πόλει, κινδύνοις ἐν ἐρημίᾳ, κινδύνοις ἐν θαλάσσῃ, κινδύνοις ἐν ψευδαδέλφοις,

controles.web: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;
controles.kjv: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;
controles.livre: Muitas vezes em viagens, em perigos de rios, em perigos de assaltantes, em perigos dos da minha nação, em perigos dos gentios, em perigos na cidade, em perigos no deserto, em perigos no mar, em perigos entre falsos irmãos;

versos.grego: κόπῳ καὶ μόχθῳ, ἐν ἀγρυπνίαις πολλάκις, ἐν λιμῷ καὶ δίψει, ἐν νηστείαις πολλάκις, ἐν ψύχει καὶ γυμνότητι·

controles.web: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.
controles.kjv: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
controles.livre: Em trabalho e fadiga, muitas vezes em vigílias, em fome e em sede, em jejuns muitas vezes, em frio e nudez.

versos.grego: χωρὶς τῶν παρεκτὸς ἡ ἐπίστασίς μοι ἡ καθ’ ἡμέραν, ἡ μέριμνα πασῶν τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν.

controles.web: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily, anxiety for all the assemblies.
controles.kjv: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.
controles.livre: Além das coisas de fora, a cada dia me vem preocupações de todas as igrejas.

versos.grego: τίς ἀσθενεῖ, καὶ οὐκ ἀσθενῶ; τίς σκανδαλίζεται καὶ οὐκ ἐγὼ πυροῦμαι;

controles.web: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?
controles.kjv: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?
controles.livre: Quem enfraquece, que eu também não enfraqueça? Quem não tropeça no pecado ,que eu não me queime por dentro ?

versos.grego: εἰ καυχᾶσθαι δεῖ, τὰ τῆς ἀσθενείας μου καυχήσομαι.

controles.web: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.
controles.kjv: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.
controles.livre: Se é necessário se orgulhar, eu me orgulharei das coisas relativas à minha fraqueza.

versos.grego: ὁ Θεὸς καὶ Πατὴρ τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ οἶδεν, ὁ ὢν εὐλογητὸς εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας, ὅτι οὐ ψεύδομαι.

controles.web: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.
controles.kjv: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.
controles.livre: O Deus e Pai de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, que é bendito eternamente, sabe que eu não estou mentindo.

versos.grego: ἐν Δαμασκῷ ὁ ἐθνάρχης Ἀρέτα τοῦ βασιλέως ἐφρούρει τὴν πόλιν Δαμασκηνῶν πιάσαι με,

controles.web: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the city of the Damascenes desiring to arrest me.
controles.kjv: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:
controles.livre: Em Damasco, o governador subordinado ao Rei Aretas pôs guardas na cidade dos damascenos, querendo me prender.

versos.grego: καὶ διὰ θυρίδος ἐν σαργάνῃ ἐχαλάσθην διὰ τοῦ τείχους καὶ ἐξέφυγον τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Through a window I was let down in a basket by the wall, and escaped his hands.
controles.kjv: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
controles.livre: E me fizeram descer num cesto por uma janela da muralha da cidade , e assim escapei das mãos dele.
